summary: SiteDocument represents a data structure for documents associated with a site, primarily containing SiteID and an ID.
purpose: To store and retrieve documents related to a Site within the HSPnet system.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the Site the document is associated with.

content_gaps: No information provided on how SiteDocument is created, updated, or retrieved beyond its basic structure.
No business rules or workflows described.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin manages the welcome screen for staff admin users, including date ranges, site/discipline selectors, application list, and error/warning panels.
purpose: To provide staff administrators with a dashboard to view employment applications, filter them by site, discipline, and date, and see relevant messages or errors.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: User input for the starting date filter.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: User input for the ending date filter.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Select site and discipline from dropdowns.
Click refresh to populate employment application grid.
Error and warning messages are handled and displayed.
View application details by clicking on name or email link.

business_rules: Start date and end date must be provided and valid.
Start date cannot be after end date.
Withdrawn applications are shown/hidden based on chkShowWithdrawn.
conditions: If SiteID is not provided, show all sites for current agency.
system_behavior: Displays grid of applications filtered by site, discipline, and date.
Handles asynchronous postbacks for drop-down changes.
Shows/hides panels for errors and warnings.
exceptions: Empty data template if no applications found.
Cancel datasource if UserSession is null.
content_gaps: No explicit business process for application approval.
Limited information on security and audit rules.

summary: ServiceCode is a data structure and its management class for codes associated with services, including categorization, naming, sorting, and localization.
purpose: To provide code lookup and management for service categorization, supporting multiple languages and integration into course/timetable options.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the service code.

workflows.name: Service Code List Retrieval
steps: Codes returned and localized if session is in alternate language mode.

workflows.name: Course/Timetable Option Retrieval
steps: Return localized codes matching course/timetable context.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true in session, use NameAlt and NotesAlt fields for display.
system_behavior: Localization based on session language settings.
Service codes retrieved via database stored procedures.

summary: SiteProfileHistory records changes to site profiles, capturing action date, user information, agency details, and localized field changes.
purpose: To maintain an audit trail of site profile changes, including what fields changed, who changed them, and under what agency context.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, and session object.
Retrieve audit records for the specified site and agency context.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, use alternate fields for ScreenSection, UserAction, and Fields.
User details are formatted for tooltips and display.
system_behavior: Audit records returned with formatted date and user info.
Phone information may be masked based on session.
content_gaps: No explicit security model for access.
No details on how site audit records are viewed or managed.

summary: EmailPopupDocument is a data structure for email popup file attachments, with management for searching and deletion of email document files.
purpose: To facilitate searching, listing, and deleting email-related file attachments for popup dialogs in HSPnet.

workflows.name: Search Email Popup Documents
steps: Parses DataInfo to extract and list file attachments.

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: Call Delete with DataInfo and document ID.
Removes file from disk and deletes directory if empty.

system_behavior: Deletes file and directory from disk if document is removed.
exceptions: File deletion and directory delete operations are wrapped in try/catch to avoid errors.
content_gaps: No explicit error reporting on failed deletions.
No business rules for file retention or security.
